walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the AQA A-Level Economics specification.

The National and International Economy appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet The National and International Economy in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with The National and International Economy.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
